description: This file defines the PostObjectV4 class which handles the creation of POST upload forms for Amazon S3 using Signature V4. It encapsulates logic for generating form attributes, inputs, and signing policies for secure uploads.

classes.name: PostObjectV4
classes.description: Handles the creation of a pre-signed form for POST uploads to Amazon S3, including policy signing and form attribute management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with client, bucket, form inputs, options, and expiration, setting up the necessary policy and signature.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the S3 client used for the operations.

methods.name: getBucket
methods.description: Returns the name of the bucket.

methods.name: getFormAttributes
methods.description: Returns the form attributes needed for the POST form.

methods.name: getFormInputs
methods.description: Returns the form inputs used in the POST form.

methods.name: setFormInput
methods.description: Sets a specific form input value.

methods.name: generateUri
methods.description: Generates the URI for the form action, considering path-style or virtual hosting.

methods.name: getPolicyAndSignature
methods.description: Creates the policy document, signs it, and returns the necessary fields for the form.
